context: Mei brings baby Hikari to visit great-grandmother Sachiko. Hina meets her young aunt-figure-baby.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖母様、ひかりちゃん、連れてきました。
lines.style: Gentle opening, tender pride in the announcement. Warm, steady breath. Slight lift on the name—presenting her like a gift. Calm, genuine affection throughout.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ひかりちゃん…会いたかった。お祖母ちゃんも、本当に、嬉しい。
lines.en: Hikari-chan… I wanted to meet you. Grandmother is truly so happy.
lines.style: Soft, trembling slightly on the opening. Wonder and emotion held close. Pace slows on 'truly'—the weight of long anticipation released. Breathing audible, gentle.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お祖母様、ひかりちゃん、可愛い！
lines.style: Bright, open-mouthed enthusiasm. No hesitation—pure joy breaking through. Quick pace on 'cute', then a warm, lingering look. Unselfconscious warmth of a child discovering something precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひな、お姉さんに、なってくれて、ありがとう。
lines.en: Hina—thank you for being a big sister to her.
lines.style: Soft address, then a pause. Sincere, meeting her eye-level. Warm gratitude underneath. Not gushing—steady and genuine, acknowledging something real she sees in the child.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひなが、ちゃんと、お姉さんに、なる！
lines.en: Hina is going to be a proper big sister!
lines.style: Earnest declaration, slight emphasis on 'proper'—she means it. Breath underneath the commitment. Quick and sure, like a promise to herself as much as to anyone listening.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こんな小さい手…。お祖父ちゃんも、絶対、見てる。
lines.en: Such small hands… Grandfather must be watching.
lines.style: Wondering gaze, voice soft as looking at the baby. Pause after the ellipsis—a quiet reaching across time. Philosophical, not mournful. Certainty underneath the tenderness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖父様の指輪、ちゃんと、ひかりちゃん、見せました。
lines.en: Grandfather's ring—I made sure to show it to Hikari-chan.
lines.style: Gentle explanation, slight emphasis on 'made sure'—a quiet promise kept. Warm and present. The deliberateness of the gesture audible in the measured pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ありがとう、メイさん。本当に、ありがとう。
lines.en: Thank you, Mei-san. Truly, thank you.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on the second thanks. Deep gratitude, not performance. Pause between the two thankyous—the weight of what she's expressing. Quiet, sincere.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひかりちゃん、ひな、優しく、お世話、するね。
lines.en: Hikari-chan, Hina will take gentle care of you.
lines.style: Solemn, childish pledge. Not playing at grown-up—genuinely earnest. Soft breath, careful articulation on 'gentle'. The seriousness of a child making a promise she will keep.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 皆で、ひかりちゃん、見守って、育てていきましょう。
lines.en: Let's all watch over and raise Hikari-chan together.
lines.style: Opening with quiet invitation, not announcement. Warmth spreading outward to include the room. Gentle lift on 'together'—drawing everyone in. Composed but genuinely moved.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: こうやって、家族、繋がっていくの、本当に、生きてて、よかった。
lines.en: Seeing the family come together like this… I'm truly grateful to be alive.
lines.style: Deep, philosophical wonder. Each phrase breathes with its own weight. Slow pace, room for silence. Not nostalgic—present tense amazement at what's in front of her. Voice warm, underlying emotion held with dignity.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お祖母様、これからも、いっぱい、お話、しようね。
lines.en: Grandmother, let's talk lots and lots from now on.
lines.style: Bright promise, child's certainty. Quick on the repetition of 'lots'—enthusiasm doubled. Open-hearted, leaning in. Completely unselfconscious—this is how she loves.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、ずっと、ずっと、ね。皆で。
lines.en: Yes, always, always. All of us together.
lines.style: Soft affirmation on 'yes'. The double 'always' gentle and unhurried—a commitment extending into indefinite time. Final phrase opens outward, including everyone. Voice settles on the last word—peace.
